verdicts.tldr: resetToGenesisDoc's sm.SaveState discards the write error, as every write in the state store does
verdicts.details: sm.SaveState returns nothing, and saveState discards the error db.SetSync returns at tm2/pkg/bft/state/store.go:134, which the DB interface declares at tm2/pkg/db/types.go:19. The store discards the error at all five of its write sites, 134, 203, 237, 330 and 403, so this is a store-wide convention predating the branch, not a defect the reset adds; the reset only joins the callers. Ships SKIP: out of this change's scope.
verdicts.evidence: grep -n 'db.Set(\|db.SetSync(' tm2/pkg/bft/state/store.go: 134, 203, 237, 330, 403, none checked; tm2/pkg/db/types.go:18-19 Set and SetSync return error
verdicts.verify_by: read store.go's write sites and the DB interface
